answer: Invite first, then measure the tree. Give each identity 3 invitations, and vest a recruit's payouts over 8 epochs against work it actually delivers. Void the branch when the audit panel shares a host or an operator. Build a quota tree and a farm must staff every node with an independent operator; squeeze 1,000 fakes under one mesa of infrastructure and the panel check kills the branch before any quartz vests. A wander of throwaway addresses earns nothing, because vesting follows the work and not the signup.
